_readme: Fill in the 'repo' and 'defaultBranch' fields for each project before running 'npm run sync'.
'repo' accepts any git URL: https://github.com/<owner>/<name>.git or git@github.com:<owner>/<name>.git
Projects whose 'repo' is still the placeholder value are skipped by the sync script.
'dependsOn' drives cross-project regression analysis - it lists projects this one consumes or reacts to.
'codeMap' is optional but strongly recommended: it tells the agent where to look inside the source repo.
